ceiling.candidate_inputs: the published funding declaration's inputs as H2's scratch panel names them
ceiling.design: H2's cross-fit (scripts/upper_bound_635.py, 10 contiguous blocks per lead, the walk-forward embargo), spread gbm only, with the lineup below; the ceiling read is the best of the lineup by CRPS on the walk-forward ordinary days, so it cannot score below the candidate's own inputs
ceiling.reading: the best-of-lineup ceiling's skill against B1 minus the reachable model's, in points of skill, with the paired 90% interval; stop reading 'no headroom' when it is positive with the lower end above 0

cuts.calendar_days: target days whose reporting day type is quarter_end, month_end or tax_date, and the coupon-settlement days (treasury_settlement_coupons > 0 on the target day), reported with their number of days and the width of the skill interval

inputs.base: the published funding declaration's features at the lead (scripts/live_record.py published_features), spread_bps among them as the as-of spread
inputs.calendar: base plus quarter_end, tax_date, days_to_month_end, net_settlement, net_settlement_due_5d
inputs.panel: the scratch panel AUG3.csv of scripts/spread_distribution_634.py's docstring plus scripts/net_settlement.py panel; the base columns are the published panel's, read with the plain registry

leaf_rule: 20 is ml.fit_gradient_boosted_quantiles' default; 5 is the smaller leaf, declared as the setting that can put a rare-day group alone on one side of a split once the training window holds 5 of them
limits: gbm_funding's declaration and scripts/final_test_preregistration.py are not changed

protocol.difference: d = S(first) - S(second); positive favours the second; skill = mean(d) / mean(S(first))
protocol.first_day_rule: a decision day is scored when every one of its five target days is on or before 2025-12-31 and has a published outcome
protocol.interval: stationary bootstrap, 10000 draws for pooled cells and 2000 for the others, seed 951; the 90% interval is the 5th to 95th percentile of the skill draws
protocol.primary_score: grid CRPS averaged with equal weight over h = 1 to 5, one number per decision day
protocol.scorer: repo_model.scoring_protocol (grid_crps, day_scores, fill_missing, paired_tests) and repo_model.protocol_benchmarks (b1_forecast, b2_forecast)

reading_rules.dilution: the calendar-day cell is read beside the pooled cell with its number of days and interval width; a gain visible on calendar days and not in the pooled cell is dilution
reading_rules.key: the second arm of the key comparison is read as carrying signal in a cut when the lower end of the 90% skill interval of its CRPS against the first is above 0 on at least 30 decision days; it is read as not seen otherwise, which is not 'no signal'
reading_rules.no_verdict: development data gives no verdict; whether the ruling of 15 October 2026 is reopened is Eleonora's
